hero.title: The people who care for this church
hero.lede: Our minister and our Shepherds (our elders) would be glad to know you.

minister.name: Kyle [Last name]
minister.bio: [Kyle to write: 3–4 sentences — how long you’ve served here, your family, what you love about Lafayette.]
minister.calloutBody: Kyle is glad to meet with you before your first Sunday. [Kyle to write: how — coffee, a phone call, or a visit to the building.]

shepherds.title: Our Shepherds
shepherds.lede: Shepherds are the men who oversee and care for the church family. Ours serve alongside their wives, and you’re welcome to talk with any of them.
